subject: Request: one-time stipend shift for BridgeLab cohorts
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@bridgelab.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-time stipend shift for BridgeLab cohorts

Sam —

Quick note following our call this morning. BridgeLab has two active cohorts (June and August). The June cohort underspent their sandbox stipend (~$6k remaining) while the August cohort is forecasted to hit heavy usage in week 2 of onboarding and will likely exceed their initial $25k stipend.

They asked whether we can move the unspent June stipend to August as a one-time top-up, rather than issuing additional promo credits. Their rationale: simpler accounting for them and faster onboarding.

Proposed Redwood approach (high level):
- Approve a one-time shift of $6,000 from June cohort pool to August cohort pool, converted to promo credits attached to the August account.
- Condition the transfer on signing a short SOW amendment (covers billing, usage floor of $5k/month for 3 months, and milestone-based top-up language).
- Invoice the shifted amount to BridgeLab and reflect as a credit line item on the next month’s invoice to keep audit trail clean.

Can we greenlight this from a sales/finance standpoint? Ben — is the invoice/credit flow above workable? Irene — anything we need from compliance/security on record-keeping or wording in the SOW?

Attaching a quick MAP and a draft SOW amendment for visibility.

Thanks,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Growth
Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0190

Attachments:
- BridgeLab-MAP.xlsx (xlsx)
- SOW-BridgeLab-draft.pdf (pdf)
From: Sam Patel <sam@bridgelab.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@bridgelab.io
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time stipend shift for BridgeLab cohorts

Tessa —

Appreciate the quick follow. That flow sounds reasonable on our side. A few clarifications:

1) We prefer the credit to be visible as a line item on the August cohort billing so our finance team can reconcile against the cohort budget.
2) The SOW amendment can be short — one paragraph to note the amount moved, the condition (sign-off on SOW), and a statement that the credit is non-transferable beyond BridgeLab cohorts.
3) On the milestone top-up: can you confirm the milestones you typically require? We want to make sure the August curriculum alignment isn’t blocked by vague criteria.

If you can get us a SOW PDF we can loop in legal and sign within 48 hours.

—Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Partnerships
BridgeLab Inc.
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@bridgelab.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time stipend shift for BridgeLab cohorts

Thanks Sam —

Irene, below are the milestone examples I usually propose for these top-ups (we can tighten language in the SOW):
- Milestone 1: August cohort completes week 2 onboarding and is actively running inference workloads for >25 distinct developer accounts.
- Milestone 2: At least one production pilot (defined as recurring ingestion + inference) starts within 60 days of cohort kickoff.

If milestones are met, we release the full $6k credit to the August pool. If not, the credit remains available for BridgeLab internal sandbox use for up to 90 days.

Ben — is the invoice/credit accounting flow ok (credit line item on August invoice) or does finance need a different treatment (e.g., separate credit memo)? I can make the SOW language match whichever flow you prefer.

Sam — I’ve attached a tightened SOW amendment draft (see filename). If that looks good I’ll send a DocuSign for signature and route the invoice flow with finance.

Cheers,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Growth
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Sam Patel <sam@bridgelab.io>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time stipend shift for BridgeLab cohorts

Tessa / Sam —

Finance is OK with the proposed approach but prefers to issue a credit memo rather than adjusting the invoice line directly — that gives a cleaner audit trail and avoids reversing revenue entries. Operationally:
- We’ll create a credit memo for $6,000 against BridgeLab’s account dated the day the DocuSign is completed.
- The credit will be applied to the August cohort invoice by default; any unused credit after 90 days will be forfeited unless explicitly extended via a signed amendment.
- For SOW wording: include an explicit sentence that the credit will be realized via credit memo; keep milestone language simple and measurable (Irene can advise exact phrasing for record-keeping).

Irene — can you propose a 1–2 sentence standard milestone clause we can insert? Also confirm whether we need any special retention of the signed SOW for compliance.

If Sam is okay with the credit memo flow I’ll ask ops to draft the memo and we’ll kick the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Director, Customer Growth Operations
Redwood Inference
